# Purpose

This document defines the approved visual design for the MVP. It answers what each canonical screen looks like.

The [MVP Experience and Screen Flows](<https://linear.app/hintology/document/canonical-mvp-experience-and-screen-flows-48e1ed94a401>) defines behavior and navigation. This document defines presentation. A screenshot cannot add behavior that the flow document does not specify.

Alex approves visual artifacts. Archived designs and their images are history only.

## Artifact status

The design direction is approved. Alex uploaded a 46-file screen and flow package on 2026-08-31. The package contains both current MVP candidates and older concepts, so upload does not equal approval.

Until an artifact is explicitly marked Approved, use the visual-system rules and canonical flow. Do not copy a screen from an archived document or infer scope from an uploaded flow board.

## Durable files

Store design files in the repository:

```text
design/
├── source/              # Editable source files such as .dc.html
├── exports/
│   └── mvp/             # Approved PNGs grouped by flow
└── README.md            # Artifact index, provenance, and status
```

Linear can display copies for review. The repository is the durable implementation reference because uploaded links and external design sessions can expire.

Do not include secrets, personal meal photos, account information, or production data.

## Status and naming

Each artifact is Candidate, Approved, or Superseded. Only Approved artifacts guide implementation.

Use `<flow>-<screen>-<state>-v<revision>.png`.

Examples:

* `onboarding-question-age-default-v1.png`
* `logging-photo-review-itemized-v1.png`
* `today-populated-within-target-v1.png`
* `today-populated-calories-over-v1.png`

Never replace an approved export with a different design under the same filename.

## Visual direction

* Dark, athletic, and number-first.
* True-black background and dark neutral surfaces.
* Cyan primary accent.
* White primary text and muted grey support text.
* Archivo for UI text and bold numerals.
* IBM Plex Mono for labels, units, dates, times, and metric strings.
* Calories are primary. Protein and fiber have equal secondary weight.
* Orange means calories over target.
* Protein or fiber above target is positive and never orange.
* Tight geometry and little decorative chrome.
* Minimum 44-point tap targets.
* No generic AI gradients, decorative badges, excessive cards, or motion without a job.

A later polish issue may use Impeccable in preserve-system mode. It must not change the direction without Alex's approval.

### First run

| -- | -- | -- |
| Welcome | default; Apple unavailable; authorization cancelled | Assets received — see review snapshot |

## 2026-08-31 asset review snapshot

All 46 PNGs and the attached manifest have been reviewed for scope. Repository copies live in `design/source/linear-2026-08-31/`; none have been copied to `design/exports/mvp/` yet.

| Files | Intake status | Decision |
| -- | -- | -- |
| 01, 02, 05–10, 12–15, 18, 21, 22, 36, 38 | Candidate | Fits the MVP direction; needs Alex's explicit approval and any missing states. |
| 03, 11, 16, 17, 19, 20, 23, 34, 37, 39 | Candidate — revise | Remove stale sequence, technical metadata, Advice, streak, password auth, Health, quota-reset, or offline copy before approval. |
| 04, 40 | Superseded | Meal-first onboarding and a skip path conflict with mandatory target-first onboarding. |
| 24–33, 35, 44 | Superseded for MVP | Retained as follow-up references for Advice, Recap, History analytics, and coaching. |
| 41–43, 45, 46 | Superseded as whole diagrams | These boards mix current screens with behavior outside or contradictory to the MVP. |

The mandatory first-run order remains Welcome → Apple authorization → verification → six questions → target result or adjustment → first-food prompt. Uploaded artwork cannot override this order.

## Intake checklist

For each gathered file:

1. Record its original session and filename.
2. Match it to one inventory row.
3. Check it against canonical scope and flow.
4. List visible stale elements.
5. Mark it Candidate.
6. Ask Alex to approve, revise, or reject it.
7. Copy approved files to `design/exports/mvp/`.
8. Update this inventory and `design/README.md`.
9. Link the approved export from its implementation issue.

## Reject or revise artifacts containing

* onboarding after the first meal or a skip action;
* email/password auth or AI-generated targets;
* streaks or analytics History;
* Advice or Recap in MVP navigation;
* push notifications or offline queued entries;
* meal grouping;
* carbs and fat;
* global ±5 macro steppers;
* temporary file metadata shown to the user.

## Implementation use

An issue cites only the approved artifacts needed for its slice. The implementation plan names those exact files.

When no approved image exists, use canonical behavior and the visual system. Keep the UI easy to revise. Do not search archived documents for a substitute.

If an approved artifact conflicts with canonical behavior, stop and ask Alex.
